svg.title: Ghanti architecture
svg.desc: A teacher and a parent talk to the server through their pages. The server turns speech into text, an agent decides what to say and which tools to run, the tools read and save school records in the DB, and the reply is turned into audio. Reports writes the daily homework and weekly call messages.
svg.text: decides what to say and do
each call is checked, run and logged
a parent only reaches their own child
